steps.text: Place the LED on the breadboard. Long leg is the anode (+).
Connect a 220 ohm resistor from the LED's short leg (cathode) to the ground rail.
steps.check: resistor bridges cathode row and ground rail

steps.text: Wire digital pin 13 to the LED's long leg.
steps.check: jumper from pin 13 to anode row

steps.text: Wire the board's GND to the breadboard ground rail.
Upload the Blink sketch and confirm the LED flashes once per second.
